node.statement: The needed finiteness does not use finite-dimensionality of S_P. Nodes 1.2.1.1--1.2.1.3 derive directly from the registered Ha identity and level-one norm axioms a universal bound ||h(Z)||<=K_1||Z||, and then, for fixed finite n and Z=[Z_ij], identify h_n(Z)=[h(Z_ij)] on the Hilbert direct sum. Thus ||h_n(Z)||<=K_1(sum_{i,j}||Z_ij||^2)^(1/2)<=n*K_1||Z||. Consequently h_n is a bounded linear map and its operator norm b_n is a finite real number. This uses only finiteness of the matrix size n, not finite-dimensionality of the corner.
